scripts.prepare-client-vendor: mkdir -p client/public/vendor && for p in node_modules/mediasoup-client/lib/mediasoup-client.min.js node_modules/mediasoup-client/dist/mediasoup-client.min.js node_modules/mediasoup-client/npm-scripts/dist/mediasoup-client.min.js; do if [ -f "$p" ]; then cp "$p" client/public/vendor/mediasoup-client.min.js; echo "Using $p"; exit 0; fi; done; echo 'mediasoup-client.min.js not found in known paths' >&2; exit 1
